title: Your Best Seller Might Earn the Least Per Plate

scenes.say: Your best seller might earn you the least on every plate.

props.headline: Your best seller might earn the *least* per plate

scenes.say: Your smash burger sells for sixteen dollars. The ingredients cost six dollars twenty, so you keep nine eighty.
The mushroom pasta sells for fourteen, but costs just three dollars ten. It keeps ten ninety.
That's a dollar ten more a plate. Move twenty burger orders a week to the pasta, and that's eleven hundred and forty-four dollars a year.
So: cost every dish. Put the quiet earners where eyes land. And try your best seller a dollar higher.
